text: Brief Introduction Global Institute of Management & Economic (GIME) at Dongbei University of Finance and Economic (DUFE) offer an BSc in TM (Tourism Management) based on teaching and research, complemented with practical application of learning during internship. This degree seeks to develop active and critical tourism professionals with an international perspective, a sound knowledge of contemporary tourism management theories, methods and practices, awareness of trends/issues in world tourism markets as well the communication, teamwork and organizational skills and competencies to work in management, marketing, planning, consultancy and research. This Tourism Management course is designed especially for overseas students who have an interest in studying tourism in China, which is expected to be the world’s top tourism destination by 2020. The course provides understanding of the tourism business and helps to develop the core skills and capabilities needed to enter a successful career in the tourism industry. While the course is featured by study of tourism management in the international context, students will also have opportunities to learn more about the country where they study, the Chinese language and the culture through relevant modules. The learning and teaching methods are a combination of lectures, seminars, tutorials, study tours and project-based assignments. Course Length 4 years excluded English courses (English for University Study) Fees Structure 1. Tuition fee:RMB 32，000per year 2. Application fee: RMB 1,000 (£100 / US $164 approx) 3. Insurance:RMB 3,530 per year(£357 / US $577 approx) 4. Physical Examination:RMB 500 5. Visa fee:RMB400/less than one year,RMB800/more than one year 6. Accommodation fee: RMB 60/day/Single Room; RMB 37/day/per person/Double Room Degree Awarded Bachelor's Degree by Dongbei University of Finance and Economics.
